d: A giant panda enjoys a playful winter day at the Giant Panda House on Sun Island in Harbin, northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. The adorable animal is seen sliding down a snow-covered slide and frolicking in the snow. Having arrived in the ice city from the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, the panda has gradually adapted to the cold winter conditions of northeast China. Its latest snow-day antics offer a delightful glimpse of how it is settling into its new environment, making the most of the snowy surroundings.
